platform: macOS local build and Linux CI build

artifact_inspection.cause: The Linux gate wrote its output under the checkout's top-level verification directory before building the source distribution. That directory was not excluded from the build input, so the archive included generated test output.

disposition: Preserved as failed delivery evidence despite green workflows. Version 0.3.4 must restrict source archive inputs, reject unexpected members, and repeat both local and Linux gates; 0.3.3 artifacts and receipts are not reused.
